tools_problematic.problem: False PASS on an intermittent startup crash. The smoke launch reported status=running ('App stayed alive 10s', pid 18412; smoke pid 28772) but the scorer's launch of the same build crashed with 0xC000027B in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll before the first frame (migration-score.json migrated_launch_status).
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log TURN 5/6 vs migration-score.json / discrepancies.json (all 7 scenarios scenario-missing, runs:false).

tool_limitations.limitation: A single 10s process-liveness check on one Debug launch cannot reliably detect a startup RACE (navigation before Activate) that only crashes on some launches.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Do not rely on the launch to catch this class; prevent the fragile pattern statically (added validator check for first navigation/initial selection inside a Window/Page constructor).

special_apis.api: NavigationView initial selection (SelectedItem = MenuItems[0]) in Page constructor
special_apis.special_handling: In WinUI 3 this fires SelectionChanged and synchronously navigates a Frame before the window is Activated / the visual tree is loaded, which can throw a native stowed exception (0xC000027B) at startup. Must be deferred to a Loaded/Activated handler.

errors_encountered.error: Startup crash 0xC000027B in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll (faulting module Microsoft.WindowsAppRuntime) before first frame; process exits within seconds; runs:false.
errors_encountered.root_cause: First Frame.Navigate ran in MainWindow ctor AND the initial NavigationView SelectedItem assignment ran in the MainPage ctor, so scenario-page construction/navigation happened before Window.Activate() — a startup-timing race.
errors_encountered.fix: Defer the first navigation and the initial NavigationView selection to a Loaded (or Window Activated) handler.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: App builds and the smoke launch passes, but the scored launch crashes before rendering.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 0 (agent never observed the crash; smoke launch passed so it declared done at TURN 7).
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Initial navigation/selection performed in constructors before Activate; the crash is intermittent so the smoke launch did not reproduce it.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A validator static check that FAILS when the initial NavigationView selection (or first Frame.Navigate) runs inside a Window/Page constructor, plus broadened MIGRATION-PATTERNS guidance that this must be deferred regardless of whether a static window reference is read.

missing_tooling.need: Static detection of 'first navigation / initial selection in a constructor' so the fragile pattern is caught at validate-time instead of relying on an intermittent launch.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The whole trial (score 0 -> the app never presented a frame).
